Mamdani Unveils Plan to Close Infamous Rikers Island, Replace It With ‘Borough-Based Jails’ by 2032. How Would It Work?

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has announced plans to shut down the city’s Rikers Island jail complex in 2032 after a century in operation, setting an end date for a site that has long been infamous for persistent violence and abuse. In its place, the city is set to open “borough-based” jails in four of its five boroughs : Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and the Bronx.
